comparison: ordinary data/selected reconstruction versus execution of an explicit prepared workspace in the same candidate build; not a pre/post timing comparison

goals.data: restore indices 0 and 1; leave missing parity unrequested
goals.parity: restore only index data_count; leave missing data unrequested
goals.mixed: restore indices 0 and data_count; leave missing data 1 unrequested

scope.counter: caller-thread alloc/alloc_zeroed/realloc requests and full requested sizes; existing serial execution
scope.setup: codec, reference encoding, plan and caller ShardSlot storage prepared outside counting; each API warmed once per fixture
scope.oracle: both outputs compared; independently check every requested/present shard against reference and every unrequested missing buffer against the dirty sentinel
scope.retention: prepared inverse and composed rows remain owned between calls; setup/retained storage outside hot allocation windows
scope.metrics: cache query witness only when benchmark-metrics is enabled; disabled zero counters are not evidence of zero queries

composition_operations.field: scalar observer implementing GF8 with no native-byte opt-in
composition_operations.model: two missing data terms times four survivor columns times one requested parity row
composition_operations.scope: existing composition moved to preparation; unchanged recovery arithmetic and payloads; not native-kernel cycle or throughput measurement

unchanged_production_checks: reconstruct.rs prefix before workspace preparers, including generic and bulk executors, byte-identical to prior_commit
ordinary reconstruct/data/some suffix and inverse-cache implementation byte-identical to prior_commit
workspace executor and format/layout validation byte-identical to prior_commit
complete recovery_plan.rs, encode.rs, matrix.rs and both field modules byte-identical to prior_commit

api_contracts.executor: reconstruct_with_workspace executes exactly the prepared targets
api_contracts.ownership: selected target indices and composed rows are owned; mask mutation/drop and original codec drop do not change the plan
api_contracts.validation: selected mask length precedes shard count; compatible format and all present lengths/erasures checked before execution
api_contracts.empty_request: valid all-false or present-only mask skips an unused singular inverse after shape/quorum validation
api_contracts.publication: retain existing per-target fallible initialization and late-error publication order
api_contracts.legacy: GF8 alias accepts full/data/parity/mixed plans via its unchanged bulk executor; legacy preparer remains full recovery
api_contracts.bounds: no new Send/Sync or field Clone/Debug constraints; Classic only; std and no_std

workspace_all_features.counting: last summary per top-level executable; exclude self-spawned duplicate summaries

validation.clippy: all targets/all features with -D warnings passed
validation.compatibility: 200 published/current non-fast configurations, exact parity, bidirectional cross-decoding and historical tower vectors passed
validation.observer_boundary: actual compilation and functional semantics; allocation data is from uninstrumented builds; formal sampler catalog not expanded

reproduction.lookup: cargo +stable test --release --locked -p rustfs-erasure-codec --features "simd-accel benchmark-metrics" --test reconstruct_workspace subset_workspace_resources -- --nocapture

remaining_gates: production bottleneck and stable timing before ordinary verify chunked scratch
production size/thread distribution and process peak budget before oversized decode cache policy changes
